title: Unless: Adding Excepto Que and Excepto Si
goal: Name the one exception that would change a plan with a menos que, a no ser que, salvo que and excepto que, and use salvo si and excepto si with the indicative.
grammar: Exceptions with the subjunctive and the indicative

items: I can name the one exception that would change a plan with a menos que, a no ser que, salvo que and excepto que.
I can use salvo si and excepto si with the indicative.
I can use the new words for exceptions and unexpected events.
